summary: Evolution Petroleum Corp filed an 8-K announcing a $0.12 per share quarterly dividend for Q4 2026, declared on May 11, 2026. The dividend is payable on June 30, 2026 to shareholders of record on June 15, 2026. The filing also includes routine financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. This is a capital return event via a regular dividend declaration. No premium, tender, or special structure applies. Watch for future dividend consistency as a measure of capital allocation strategy.
